items.title: Frank Wess — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I don’t know any jazz groups that have played there recently... I don’t have any connection with Washington other than Billy Taylor

ctx.x: Yeah, I haven’t heard anything about it. Ken Kimery: They’ve actually been doing quite well.
Oh good! Good! Ken Kimery: Ron Carter has been in there. So, they’ve been making great strides.
I don’t know any jazz groups that have played there recently, you know?
